name: Salinas (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Green field charged with a row of five white isosceles triangles across the centre, for the hills of salt that gave the town its name.
history: Salinas is a town and municipality in the southern part of Puerto Rico located in the southern coast of the island, south of Aibonito and Cayey; southeast of Coamo, east of Santa Isabel; and west of Guayama.

features.role: row of five triangles for the salt hills
